$Comment: The zone 1 plains, split out of Talus_Zone1 so the Roaming Temple can spawn here and nowhere else. An environment is owned by exactly one rule and a second rule naming it is ignored, so the plains needs a rule of its own. Chance and the two talus weights match Talus_Zone1, so a talus is no rarer here than in the forest next door.

The temple is fifteen of the forty-five weight, so one roll in three of the cells the seed occupies, or about one plains cell in nine once Chance is applied. Two further multipliers sit under that: only a fraction of zone 1 is plains, and the temple has to find ground its legs can stand on across a twenty-eight block footprint against the four a talus asks for.
